identity.command_policy: Finite-value validation only; no custom command envelopes, clipping or joint-position aborts. Original simulator behaviour retained.
identity.trace_policy: Every 10ms plus terminal observation; differences on shared sampled times, not identical states.
identity.feature_calculation: goal35_v1: baseline observations rounded to float32 first; geometry calculated in float64, then appended as float32. Production height-dependent standoff and origin-based target bearing; heading wrapped with atan2(sin(error),cos(error)); atan2(0,0)=0 convention.

preprocessing.output_policy: Training-fitted standardisation; predictions inverted for physical-unit metrics

goal35.stop_reason: Target not reachable: closest pose reached at t=8.00s (best EE error 0.2614 m, current 0.4812 m)

actuator_limits.note: Informational only: no additional evaluation command/position limits; existing simulator actuator behaviour is unchanged.

production_joint6_initial_state.note: Original production pose preserved; informational only, no custom position guard.

goal35.maximum_policy: Finite raw predictions, including rejected commands; nonfinite values recorded in guard_violation.
goal35.minimum_policy: All observed 1ms steps, including terminal observation
